property_summary: For any caller, Collect(_am) succeeds only when balances[msg.sender] >= MinSum && balances[msg.sender] >= _am, so balances[msg.sender] can never decrease below MinSum through Collect; the mutant removes this precondition, letting a caller with balance below MinSum withdraw via Collect (using a reverting Log so no side-effects on balances from Log matter), so balances decreases when it should be unchanged.
change_summary: Delete the balance precondition guard in Collect, allowing collections even when the caller's balance is below MinSum or the requested amount.
